acceptance.given: Toolchain replay executes enable, disable, behavioral rollback, and re-enable for each applicable Consumer using the real call surface.

oracle.expected: For every applicable Consumer, post-flow route identity and verdict/diagnostic output match the captured Prior Route baseline.
forbidden: Any Consumer has verdict or diagnostics differing from its established baseline.
Any Consumer is omitted from the flow.
oracle.observable: Per-Consumer replay records contain prior-route identity, baseline hashes, post-flow hashes, and equality checks.

acceptance.then: The applicable Consumer has its verdict/diagnostic baseline restored.
acceptance.when: After the enable, disable, behavioral rollback, and re-enable flow completes.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select a Consumer replay whose post-flow verdict or diagnostics differ from the captured baseline; verification must fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Restore Prior Route identity and verdict/diagnostic baseline for every applicable Consumer through enable, disable, rollback, and re-enable.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve replay result schema and Consumer call-surface compatibility; rollback only baseline-restoration logic.

slice_hint.state_transition: Pre-restoration Consumer verdict/diagnostics -> enable -> disable -> behavioral rollback -> re-enable -> baseline-equal verdict/diagnostics.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: All applicable Consumers have baseline equality and restored route identity; mismatch or omission is failure.

acceptance.given: The evaluation-seed manifest and provenance records are available for inspection.

oracle.expected: Each of the three named evaluation seeds is represented exactly once with provenance, applicability, missing-label status, counterexample or explicit absence, and approved non-baseline classification.
forbidden: Any named seed occurs zero times.
Any named seed occurs more than once.
oracle.observable: A structured seed-manifest validation report lists each required seed once with occurrence count 1 and all required metadata fields.

acceptance.then: The three specified evaluation seeds each have exactly one complete record.
acceptance.when: During evaluation of the FR-6 seed manifest.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select a manifest containing a missing or duplicate named seed; exact-once and completeness validation must fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Validate deterministically that each named evaluation seed occurs exactly once and has all required metadata.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Keep existing seed manifest format readable; rollback only exact-once metadata validation.

slice_hint.state_transition: Unvalidated seed records -> occurrence counting and metadata checks -> accepted manifest or rejection.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Success only when all three required seeds have count 1 and complete metadata; otherwise deterministic failure.

acceptance.given: Six materially distinct Matrix Case fixtures and state are prepared, and the Stable subject is immutable for the run.

oracle.expected: Every one of the six Matrix Cases has a completed execution record for the same immutable Stable subject, with case identity and attributable evidence.
forbidden: Any Matrix Case lacks Stable-subject execution.
Stable-subject content or identity changes during execution.
Evidence cannot be attributed to a specific Matrix Case.
oracle.observable: Matrix aggregate records show six distinct case IDs, identical Stable subject digest per case, completion status, and evidence references.

acceptance.then: All six Matrix Cases have executed their immutable Stable subjects.
acceptance.when: When the six Matrix Cases are executed and the aggregate is evaluated.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select a six-case matrix fixture with one missing Stable execution record or a changed Stable digest; matrix verification must fail.

affected_subjects: Stable subject execution across all six materially distinct Matrix Cases
slice_hint.behavior_change: Execute and record the immutable Stable subject for each of six distinct Matrix Cases with per-case attribution and stable digest equality.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve matrix result schema and fixture distinctness; rollback only Stable execution/recording changes.

slice_hint.state_transition: Six designated cases without Stable records -> immutable Stable execution per case -> six attributed completed records.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Success only if all six distinct case IDs contain completed records sharing one Stable subject digest; omission, mutation, or attribution gap fails.

acceptance.given: An external Toolchain process is launched under bounded time and output limits.

oracle.expected: The process reaches a terminal state within configured bounds, and repeated executions with identical inputs reach the same terminal state and result classification.
forbidden: The process remains running past the bound.
Terminal state or classification differs across identical reruns.
Budget exhaustion is reported as success.
oracle.observable: Process records contain bounded duration/output, terminal status, deterministic classification, and repeat-consistency comparison.

acceptance.then: The external process is in a deterministic terminal state.
acceptance.when: When external process execution terminates and repeatability is evaluated.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select a bounded process invocation that times out, exceeds output budget, or yields differing terminal classifications across identical reruns; verification must fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce bounded execution and output with deterministic terminal-state capture and repeat-consistency checks for each external process.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Retain process result fields and classify budget exhaustion as unsuccessful; rollback only deterministic terminal enforcement.

slice_hint.state_transition: Running external process -> bounded execution -> terminal success/failure with captured status -> repeated identical-run comparison.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Each process must terminate within bounds and produce a repeat-stable classification; timeout, budget exhaustion, or divergence is failure.
